_comment: The healing setting (owner, 2026-10-23: no more notes from me). Read by tools/heal.py. Loop: gate -> critic -> classify -> fix -> rerun -> learn. See pipelines/HEAL.md.

budget._comment: Tokens are summed from the --tokens each round records (the Lead copies them from the agent receipts). Minutes run from the first heal snapshot.

critic._comment: the owner's scale: Mix v2 = 6, art book first pass = 8, Mix v5 and shot 2 = 10. The critic cannot score higher than the rubric allows: heal.py recomputes the score from the faults.

fixer._comment: Sonnet 5.5 only for every agent (owner, 2026-10-23): no Opus, no Haiku. The crew lives in .claude/agents/sw-*.md. Creative and tool faults differ by brief, not by model.

on_budget_exhausted._comment: When rounds or budget run out: stop, list every remaining fault with its class and evidence, mark the build BLOCKED. Never loosen a gate. Never show the owner unhealed work as done.

protected_paths._comment: frozen = no heal round may change it (a threshold change is a Lead-merged proposal under R-212 with a measured sample, never part of a heal). regenerated_only = traces, masks and gate outputs may change only because their stage re-ran (STATE.json says so), never by hand.

owner_ready._comment: Only then does the Lead add the preview tab and open it.
